name: dev-agents
description: Inventory the coding agents, MCP servers and plugins a repository's development process depends on, decide with the user which organization stands behind each one, and land them in Noru as vendors plus one evidence record for the window — never anything per person.

interface.shortDescription: Record the coding agents, MCP servers and plugins your development depends on as reviewed suppliers.
interface.longDescription: Reads an agent-change-control manifest for the coding agents that authored changes in a window and their vendors, and the repository's committed Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Gemini CLI configuration for the MCP servers and plugins it declares, recording a server by its command name or host only. A person decides which organization stands behind each one; the result lands in Noru as vendors and one evidence record for the window, linked to controls from Noru's own queue. Per-person agent usage is never aggregated unless asked, and then only into a local cache file.
capabilities: Local read: agent-change-control manifest and committed agent configuration files
Local write: .noru/dev-agents.yml and machine-only cache files
Noru read: organization, vendors, controls and existing evidence
Noru write: vendors and one evidence record, only after diff and confirmation
MCP servers recorded by command name or host only, never env, headers, args or URLs
Never records who ran an agent
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me which coding agents, MCP servers and plugins this repository depends on. Do not push or write to Noru.
